name: anchor: resources — registry, roles on resources, access
description: anchor#281-#284 (ADR-0022 PRs 11-14, DR-D11) in one Organization of an own product. Registry: top-down registration, idempotent PUT, refusals (INVALID_RESOURCE_PARENT, PARENT_NOT_REGISTERED, RESOURCE_CYCLE, RESOURCE_TYPE_NOT_REGISTRABLE, INVALID_RESOURCE_ID, read-only key 403, RESOURCE_IN_USE), rename, move, search, cascade delete. Roles on resources: assign, refusals, revoke. Decisions on a registered folder, an unregistered document by its parent (granted_by), deny reasons. resource.* stays internal, resource.role_assignment.* is delivered. Custom roles per type: switch per type, a project custom role granting below its resource; a re-parent strips its permission while a managed role answers 409; a type delete takes its unheld custom role. The platform session evaluates too (#286). Workspaces are resources: the deprecated route writes and deletes both, the resource routes refuse to delete one (#287). Generator: echopoint-investigation/gen_resources.py.
